name: packet_and_pw_ingress
purpose: Prove exact ARP/NDP packet type and ingress role before judging DNOS behavior.
commands: spirent_loss_verify / stream metadata for ARP/ND packet type
xray_arrival_compare for PW ingress capture with arp.opcode / icmpv6.type / vlan / mpls labels
packet capture on PW ingress and AC egress during active traffic

name: dn_arch_counters
purpose: Prove the frame entered the DUT and, when expected, flooded to AC.
commands: show evpn instance <service> vpls-pw counters | no-more
show interfaces <local_ac_interface> counters | no-more
show interfaces <pw_core_or_bundle_interface> counters | no-more

name: dp_proxyarp_classification
purpose: Prove DP classified the source as VPLS PW (ARP-FROM-PW indication via PMF PweInLifWideData, comment 816399) and made the expected punt/recycle decision.
commands: xraycli /wb_agent/proxy_arp/rx
xraycli /wb_agent/proxy_arp/msg_recv
xraycli /wb_agent/pmf/pwe_in_lif
show file traces datapath/wb_agent.evpn | include regex "<mac>|<ip>|ProxyArp|is_vpls_pw|ARP-FROM-PW|PweInLifWideData|NDP|ARP"
show file traces datapath/wb_pkt_proc | include regex "<mac>|<ip>|ProxyArp|is_vpls_pw|ARP-FROM-PW|GRE-IRB|MACT_Recycle|RawSocket|NDP|ARP"

name: proxy_reply_direction_guard
purpose: Prove no generated proxy ARP/NDP reply egresses toward VPLS PW.
commands: xraycli /wb_agent/proxy_arp/tx
xraycli /wb_agent/proxy_arp/msg_sent
xray_arrival_compare on PW egress for generated ARP reply / NA
show interfaces <pw_core_or_bundle_interface> counters | no-more

name: routing_neighbor_learning
purpose: Prove Routing learns only in IRB in-subnet mode and stays empty for no-IRB/out-of-subnet cases.
commands: show arp vrf <vrf> ipv4-address <pw_source_ipv4> | no-more
show ndp vrf <vrf> ipv6-address <pw_source_ipv6> | no-more
show dnos-internal routing fib-manager database neighbor address <pw_source_ipv4> | no-more
show dnos-internal routing fib-manager database neighbor address <pw_source_ipv6> | no-more
show file traces routing_engine/neighbour_manager_oob_ns | include regex "<pw_source_ipv4>|<pw_source_ipv6>|<pw_source_mac_ipv4>|<pw_source_mac_ipv6>"

name: evpn_mac_ip_state
purpose: Prove EVPN ARP/NDP/MAC-IP tables reflect the Routing learn and source role.
commands: show evpn arp-table instance <irb_service> ip <pw_source_ipv4> | no-more
show evpn ndp-table instance <irb_service> ip <pw_source_ipv6> | no-more
show evpn mac-ip-table instance <irb_service> ip <pw_source_ipv4> | no-more
show evpn mac-ip-table instance <irb_service> ip <pw_source_ipv6> | no-more
show evpn mac-table instance <irb_service> mac <pw_source_mac_ipv4> | no-more
show evpn mac-table instance <irb_service> mac <pw_source_mac_ipv6> | no-more

name: fib_manager_programming
purpose: Prove fib-manager backing DB and traces agree with EVPN/Routing state.
commands: show dnos-internal routing fib-manager database evpn local-mac service-instance <irb_service> | include regex "<pw_source_mac_ipv4>|<pw_source_mac_ipv6>|<pw_source_ipv4>|<pw_source_ipv6>"
show dnos-internal routing fib-manager database evpn remote-mac service-instance <irb_service> | include regex "<pw_source_mac_ipv4>|<pw_source_mac_ipv6>|<pw_source_ipv4>|<pw_source_ipv6>"
show dnos-internal routing fib-manager database evpn evi-id <evi_id> l2-neighbor ip <pw_source_ipv4> | no-more
show dnos-internal routing fib-manager database evpn evi-id <evi_id> l2-neighbor ip <pw_source_ipv6> | no-more
show dnos-internal routing fib-manager database l2-maintained-neighbors instance <irb_service> | no-more
show file traces routing_engine/fibmgrd_traces | include regex "<pw_source_mac_ipv4>|<pw_source_ipv4>|<pw_source_mac_ipv6>|<pw_source_ipv6>|EvpnLocalMac|EvpnPwMac|L2Neighbor"

name: rib_manager_and_zebra_path
purpose: Prove the RIB/zebra side accepted or rejected the EVPN neighbor state before fib-manager.
commands: show file traces routing_engine/rib-manager_traces | include regex "<pw_source_mac_ipv4>|<pw_source_ipv4>|<pw_source_mac_ipv6>|<pw_source_ipv6>|EVPN|neighbor|l2-neighbor|ARP|NDP"
debug_routing_vtysh_bundle with mac/ip/evi filters when DNOS CLI and fib-manager disagree

name: datapath_forwarding_owner
purpose: Prove DP owner/egress agrees with Routing/fib-manager.
commands: show evpn forwarding-table mac-address-table instance <irb_service> mac <pw_source_mac_ipv4> | no-more
show evpn forwarding-table mac-address-table instance <irb_service> mac <pw_source_mac_ipv6> | no-more

name: bgp_rt2_non_origination
purpose: Prove PW-source MAC-IP is not illegally originated as local RT-2.
commands: show bgp l2vpn evpn route-type 2 | include regex "<pw_source_mac_ipv4>|<pw_source_ipv4>|<pw_source_mac_ipv6>|<pw_source_ipv6>|ESI|best"
show file traces routing_engine/bgpd_traces | include regex "<pw_source_mac_ipv4>|<pw_source_ipv4>|<pw_source_mac_ipv6>|<pw_source_ipv6>|route-type 2|RT-2"

name: cprl_contamination_guard
purpose: Prove ARP/NDP behavior is not explained by control-plane rate limiting.
commands: show system cprl | no-more
show config system cprl | no-more
show system logging system-events CPRL_RATE_LIMIT_CROSSED | no-more
